testSummary.notes: All tests require valid credentials and access to the VIB LexGPT application

setup: Ensure test file is in tests directory
run: Run all tests: npx playwright test lexgpt.spec.ts
Run specific test: npx playwright test lexgpt.spec.ts -g 'TC01'
Run with UI: npx playwright test --ui
Run headed (see browser): npx playwright test --headed

results.format: JSON with test results, status, and details
